tagline.en_US: Telegram is a cloud-based mobile and desktop messaging app.

description.en_US: Telegram is a cloud-based mobile and desktop messaging application. It allows users to communicate and exchange messages across devices from a single account.

tips: Copy and paste between your computer and the streamed desktop, including images, works over HTTPS: port 3001 or an HTTPS reverse proxy. Browsers block clipboard access over plain HTTP.
